abstract: Medical imaging agents already return answers on heterogeneous imaging surfaces, yet deployment still faces a limited verification budget where each wrong accept can harm clinical trust. When a thin check and a deeper evidence pass disagree on the same case, deciding when to stop, open more evidence, repair, or reject without a shared controller remains ill-posed. Tool-using workflows often lock a surface-specific evidence order per dataset, or a private always-open full-depth verification path; those pipelines stay costly, leave many wrong accepts, and cannot share one controller across modalities. We present MedHarness, a registered multi-surface runtime reliability layer that reformulates post-answer control as shared decision-object attachment after a proposer's initial prediction. Under Shared Decision Object, Minimum-Sufficient Verification, and Intermediate Repair, one shared policy with surface recipe adapters lets a new imaging surface join the same stop / open-evidence / repair / reject controller by recipe registration. On a 512-case live pool, MedHarness cuts wrong accepts versus a full-verification baseline by about 47% and raises accepted accuracy to 83.2% vs. 72.9% at 86.1% coverage versus full release under that baseline. On a failure-enriched multi-surface stress ranking, the same controller cuts estimated remote service calls per case by about 71% versus that baseline under a matched context-load setting. A held-out three-surface check and an alternate language-model transfer keep the same control ordering. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MedHarness-paper-release-A7F3/.
zh_abstract: 医学影像智能体已能在异构的影像界面上给出答案，但实际部署仍面临有限的验证预算，每一次错误接受都可能损害临床信任。当浅层核查与更深层的证据检查在同一病例上结果不一致时，在缺乏共享控制器的情况下，要决定何时停止、打开更多证据、修复或拒绝，仍然是一个不适定的问题。使用工具的工作流往往为每个数据集固定特定界面的证据顺序，或采用私有的、始终开启的全深度验证路径；这些流程成本高昂，仍会留下许多错误接受，并且无法在不同模态之间共享同一个控制器。我们提出 MedHarness，这是一个经注册的多界面运行时可靠性层，它将答案后控制重新表述为在提议器给出初始预测之后的共享决策对象附加。在共享决策对象（Shared Decision Object）、最小充分验证（Minimum-Sufficient Verification）和中间修复（Intermediate Repair）机制下，一个带有界面配方适配器的共享策略，可使新的影像界面通过配方注册加入同一个“停止/打开证据/修复/拒绝”控制器。在一个包含 512 例病例的实时池上，与全验证基线相比，MedHarness 将错误接受减少约 47%，并将被接受病例的准确率从 72.9% 提高到 83.2%，覆盖率为 86.1%（对比该基线下的全量放行）。在一个富含失败案例的多界面压力排序上，在匹配的上下文负载设置下，同一控制器相比该基线将每例估计的远程服务调用次数减少约 71%。一项留出的三界面检验以及另一种语言模型的迁移实验保持了相同的控制排序。代码见 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MedHarness-paper-release-A7F3/。

title: SCOUT: Risk-Guided Foundation-Model Escalation for Robust Tissue Detection in Whole-Slide Images
zh_title: SCOUT：风险引导的病理基础模型级联组织检测
summary: 提出风险引导级联方法：轻量审计网络定位易错区域，再由冻结的病理基础模型选择性修正缩略图组织掩膜，以减少漏检并限制假阳性。
key_points: 轻量审计网络估计分割错误的空间分布
非对称共识规则整合基础模型预测与初始掩膜
校准的切片级复核评分用于控制复核
reason: 病理基础模型的新方法预印本，摘要未见量化结果，属值得一看档
abstract: Reliable tissue detection is essential for whole-slide image analysis, yet high average segmentation accuracy can conceal failures involving pale tissue, small fragments, and heterogeneous staining. Pathology foundation models offer transferable representations, but exhaustive inference is computationally demanding and may introduce false-positive tissue predictions. We propose SCOUT (Selective Correction of Uncertain Tissue), a risk-guided cascade that selectively refines an initial thumbnail-based tissue mask. A lightweight audit network estimates the spatial distribution of segmentation errors and prioritizes candidate regions for processing by a frozen pathology foundation model. An asymmetric consensus rule integrates the resulting predictions with the initial mask to recover missed tissue while limiting false positives. A calibrated slide-level review score additionally controls the marginal rate of unflagged case-group failures under the calibration assumptions. Evaluation on a public multi-source, multi-stain benchmark shows that SCOUT reduces the proportion of case groups requiring mask correction from 38.1% for the best released detector to 18.6%, with particularly pronounced improvements in immunohistochemistry. Source-held-out experiments demonstrate better generalization than a segmentation network trained on the same annotations, while selective inference achieves an observed failure rate no higher than processing all candidate regions. Downstream, lymph-node classification with SCOUT masks is non-inferior to that obtained with two of the three released detectors evaluated. A variant built on an openly licensed foundation model is publicly released as an installable Python package with trained weights. These results support risk-guided foundation-model inference as an effective approach to tissue detection across heterogeneous histopathology data.
zh_abstract: 可靠的组织检测对全切片图像分析至关重要，但较高的平均分割准确率可能掩盖在淡染组织、小碎片和染色异质性方面的失败。病理基础模型可提供可迁移的表征，但穷尽式推理计算量大，并可能引入假阳性的组织预测。我们提出 SCOUT（Selective Correction of Uncertain Tissue，不确定组织的选择性校正），这是一种风险引导的级联方法，可对基于缩略图的初始组织掩码进行选择性优化。一个轻量级审核网络估计分割错误的空间分布，并优先挑选候选区域交由冻结的病理基础模型处理。一种非对称共识规则将所得预测与初始掩码整合，以找回遗漏的组织，同时限制假阳性。经校准的切片级复核评分还可在校准假设下控制未被标记的病例组失败的边际发生率。在一个公开的多来源、多染色基准上的评估显示，SCOUT 将需要掩码校正的病例组比例由已发布最佳检测器的 38.1% 降至 18.6%，其中免疫组织化学的改善尤为显著。留出来源实验表明，其泛化性优于使用相同标注训练的分割网络，而选择性推理所观察到的失败率不高于处理全部候选区域。在下游任务中，使用 SCOUT 掩码进行淋巴结分类，其表现不劣于所评估的三个已发布检测器中的两个。基于开放许可基础模型构建的一个变体已作为可安装的 Python 包连同训练权重公开发布。这些结果支持将风险引导的基础模型推理作为跨异质组织病理数据进行组织检测的有效方法。

title: SIGMA: speaker-isolated, symptom-structured multimodal estimation of depression severity from clinical interviews
zh_title: SIGMA：基于访谈的说话人隔离、症状结构化多模态抑郁严重度估计
summary: 提出利用说话人分离、跨模态注意力和联合预测八个问卷条目的框架，从半临床访谈估计抑郁严重度，在E-DAIC上报告领先表现。
key_points: 说话人分离仅保留受访者语音
文本、音频、视频跨模态注意力融合
共享潜在严重度的分级响应头联合预测条目
reason: 精神健康多模态新方法，有基线对比，仅单一数据集；命中偏好
abstract: Clinical interviews are central to depression assessment but time-consuming and rater-dependent. Automated severity estimation offers scalable screening, yet existing methods often retain interviewer speech (confounding participant cues), fuse modalities late (losing fine-grained cross-modal dynamics), or score symptoms independently (ignoring inter-symptom correlations). We present SIGMA, a speaker-aware, symptom-structured framework for depression-severity estimation from semi-clinical interviews. SIGMA uses speaker diarization to restrict input to participant speech, cross-attention so that text, audio and video condition one another during encoding, and a graded-response head that predicts the eight questionnaire items jointly through a shared latent severity trait with item-specific ordered thresholds. On the Extended Distress Analysis Interview Corpus, SIGMA achieves state-of-the-art performance (CCC 0.762, RMSE 4.13, MAE 3.30 over five seeds). Ablations confirm that isolating participant speech and joint, structured symptom prediction each substantially improve concordance and estimation accuracy.
zh_abstract: 临床访谈是抑郁评估的核心，但耗时且依赖评估者。自动化严重程度估计可提供可扩展的筛查，然而现有方法往往保留访谈者的语音（干扰参与者线索）、在后期融合各模态（丢失细粒度的跨模态动态），或独立地对各症状评分（忽略症状间的相关性）。我们提出SIGMA，一种说话人感知、症状结构化的框架，用于从半临床访谈中估计抑郁严重程度。SIGMA利用说话人日志（speaker diarization）将输入限定为参与者的语音，采用交叉注意力使文本、音频和视频在编码过程中相互条件化，并采用分级响应头，通过共享的潜在严重程度特质及各条目特有的有序阈值联合预测问卷的八个条目。在扩展版Distress Analysis Interview Corpus上，SIGMA取得了最先进的性能（五个随机种子下CCC 0.762、RMSE 4.13、MAE 3.30）。消融实验证实，分离参与者语音以及联合的结构化症状预测均显著提高了一致性和估计准确性。

title: Learning spatial cellular state through 3D reconstruction of the cell
zh_title: 通过细胞三维重建学习空间细胞状态
summary: 提出将细胞建模为带基因注释的转录本点云，用旋转等变网络重建3D细胞形状，得到空间感知的转录本嵌入并汇总为细胞状态表示。
key_points: 亚细胞分辨率空间转录组的表示学习框架
旋转等变网络重建细胞3D形状
转录本嵌入聚合为细胞状态表示
reason: 新颖方法的预印本，摘要未见充分对比，属值得一看档
abstract: Subcellular-resolution spatial transcriptomics localizes individual RNA transcripts within cells with high-precision. Existing methods for identifying spatially organized cell populations rely on cellular niches defined by neighboring cells, leaving open whether such populations can be identified from individual-cell representations alone. Moreover, representations that jointly capture transcript identity and three-dimensional (3D) spatial organization have not been systematically learned or biologically evaluated. Here we present a representation learning framework that models each cell as a gene-annotated point cloud of transcripts and trains a rotation-equivariant neural network to reconstruct 3D cell shape, yielding spatially informed transcript embeddings. We further aggregate these embeddings into a cell-state representation that summarizes transcript-level spatial patterns. Our framework outperforms existing point-cloud-based 3D reconstruction methods on cell-shape reconstruction. In MERFISH human uterine cancer, combining the learned embeddings with gene expression improved prediction of CD45RO protein intensity over both gene expression alone and niche-based embeddings. Applied to MERFISH human liver cancer and Xenium human lung datasets, our framework identified distinct spatial patterns between cell populations, including spatially organized subpopulations marked by disease-associated gene expression and patterns associated with pathological tissue structures. Together, these results show that learning transcript representations through 3D cell reconstruction provides a novel approach to capture cell-state heterogeneity and biologically relevant spatial organization in subcellular spatial transcriptomics.
zh_abstract: 亚细胞分辨率空间转录组学能够以高精度定位细胞内的单个RNA转录本。现有用于识别空间组织化细胞群体的方法依赖于由邻近细胞定义的细胞微环境（niche），因而尚不清楚能否仅凭单个细胞的表征识别此类群体。此外，能够同时捕捉转录本身份与三维（3D）空间组织的表征尚未被系统地学习或进行生物学评估。在此，我们提出一种表征学习框架，将每个细胞建模为带有基因注释的转录本点云，并训练一个旋转等变神经网络来重建3D细胞形状，从而获得具有空间信息的转录本嵌入。我们进一步将这些嵌入聚合为细胞状态表征，以概括转录本层面的空间模式。在细胞形状重建方面，我们的框架优于现有基于点云的3D重建方法。在MERFISH人类子宫癌数据中，将所学嵌入与基因表达结合，相比单独使用基因表达以及基于微环境的嵌入，均改善了对CD45RO蛋白强度的预测。应用于MERFISH人类肝癌和Xenium人类肺部数据集时，我们的框架识别出细胞群体之间不同的空间模式，包括以疾病相关基因表达为标志的空间组织化亚群，以及与病理组织结构相关的模式。总之，这些结果表明，通过3D细胞重建来学习转录本表征，为在亚细胞空间转录组学中捕捉细胞状态异质性和具有生物学意义的空间组织提供了一种新方法。

title: BiomedCAT: Biomedical Context Analysis Tool for Supporting Mechanistic Hypothesis Generation via User-defined Contextual Subgraph Extraction
zh_title: BiomedCAT：从幻灯片构建知识图谱子图以支持机制假设生成
summary: 开源本地工作流，利用小型视觉语言模型和智能体将生物医学幻灯片转为RTX-KG2c知识图谱子图，用于假设生成。
key_points: 本地运行，文档不外传
4B智能体在合成基准上准确率0.71
存在性校验以去除虚构实体
reason: 新颖智能体方法，开源，证据有限；契合科学发现方向
abstract: Researchers formulate mechanistic hypotheses in slides and figures long before they write them as text, yet knowledge-graph (KG) tools expect a query in the vocabulary of the graph. We present BiomedCAT, an open-source workflow that turns biomedical slides into a subgraph of the RTX-KG2c knowledge graph shaped by the user's research profile, on a laptop and without sending the documents out. A small vision-language model describes each slide; a 4-billion-parameter agent types the terms into the classes of the Biolink model; an existence gate removes invented entities; identifiers are retrieved from Translator services or from a local table and selected, never generated, by a judge model; and a profile-weighted two-hop expansion builds the context graph. On a synthetic Biolink typing benchmark whose labels were audited by an expert, the local agent reaches 0.71 accuracy on 517 non-ambiguous mentions, 4 points below Claude Opus 5 (0.75), level with DeepSeek-V4-Flash (0.69) and above open-weight models of 24 and 31 billion parameters; the audit also showed that 55% of the generated labels were wrong or ambiguous. On expert-annotated slide decks, the reading stage recovers 81 to 94% of the explicit terms of the English deck, less on French decks, and linking assigns the expert identifier to 65% of the found terms online and 26% in the fully local mode. A one-slide run takes 33 to 42 minutes, with peaks of 9.8~GB of system RAM above idle and 5.3~GB of GPU memory. In a facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD) case, three slides that each draw one pathway from DUX4 at a different biological scale give graphs that overlap by 7 to 15% of their nodes, each recovering its own pathway's expected nodes, and expose sourced paths from DUX4, such as a DUX4--HMGB1 interaction from IntAct. Of 21 compounds tested in FSHD, seven, including every agent that targets DUX4, are absent from RTX-KG2c, which bounds what a graph-based approach can propose. BiomedCAT lets a researcher set a working hypothesis against curated knowledge, with every edge traceable to its source.
zh_abstract: 研究者在以文字表述之前，早已在幻灯片和图表中形成机制性假设，然而知识图谱（KG）工具要求使用图谱词汇来进行查询。我们提出 BiomedCAT，这是一个开源工作流，可在笔记本电脑上、无需将文档外传，将生物医学幻灯片转换为 RTX-KG2c 知识图谱中由用户研究画像塑造的子图。一个小型视觉语言模型描述每张幻灯片；一个40亿参数的智能体将术语归入 Biolink 模型的类别；存在性校验环节剔除虚构实体；标识符从 Translator 服务或本地表中检索，并由裁判模型选择而非生成；随后通过按研究画像加权的两跳扩展构建上下文图。在一个经专家审核标签的合成 Biolink 类型标注基准上，本地智能体在517个无歧义提及上达到0.71的准确率，比 Claude Opus 5（0.75）低4个百分点，与 DeepSeek-V4-Flash（0.69）持平，并高于240亿和310亿参数的开放权重模型；审核还显示，55%的生成标签错误或存在歧义。在专家标注的幻灯片集上，阅读阶段可召回英文幻灯片集中81%至94%的显式术语，法文幻灯片集则较低；链接环节在联网时为找到的术语赋予专家标识符的比例为65%，在完全本地模式下为26%。单张幻灯片的运行耗时33至42分钟，系统内存比空闲状态峰值高出9.8 GB，GPU 内存为5.3 GB。在面肩肱型肌营养不良（FSHD）案例中，三张幻灯片各自在不同生物学尺度上描绘了从 DUX4 出发的一条通路，所得图谱节点重叠7%至15%，各自召回其所在通路的预期节点，并揭示了来自 DUX4 的有出处支持的路径，如来自 IntAct 的 DUX4--HMGB1 相互作用。在FSHD中测试的21种化合物中，有7种（包括所有靶向 DUX4 的药物）不在 RTX-KG2c 中，这限定了基于图谱的方法所能提出的范围。BiomedCAT 使研究者能够将工作假设与经整理的知识相对照，且每条边均可追溯至其来源。

title: scUNVEIL: Learning scRNA-seq Cell Embeddings Through Measurement Enrichment
zh_title: scUNVEIL：通过测量增强学习scRNA-seq细胞嵌入
summary: 提出基于下一个UMI预测的自监督模型，用残差MLP直接处理计数向量，得到细胞嵌入与测量增强的基因表达。
key_points: 证明贝叶斯最优预测器为后验均值
无需基因token注意力机制
单一低维隐状态作为细胞嵌入
reason: 有新意的单细胞预训练方法，预印本，证据有限
abstract: Large-scale pretraining can improve scRNA-seq representations through measurement enrichment: estimating what the same measurement would reveal at greater UMI depth under the same measurement process. We introduce scUNVEIL, a self-supervised model trained through next-UMI prediction. We show that the Bayes-optimal next-UMI predictor is the posterior mean of the transcriptome composition that arbitrarily deep sequencing would reveal. Because UMI identities are exchangeable conditional on transcriptome composition, scUNVEIL operates directly on count vectors using a residual multilayer perceptron, without attention over gene tokens. The measurement-enriched transcriptome composition is predicted from a single low-dimensional hidden state, which therefore serves naturally as the cell embedding. The same model provides both reusable cell representations and measurement-enriched gene-expression estimates. scUNVEIL was pretrained without labels or auxiliary metadata on approximately 92 million human cells spanning diverse tissues. Under linear evaluation on fine-grained cell-type annotation, its zero-shot representations achieved the best performance among the evaluated methods, while providing over 1000-fold faster inference than the strongest evaluated transformer-based foundation model and matching that model's predictive performance using 88% fewer input UMIs per cell. Further evaluations show that these representations improve prediction of tumor reactivity, mitochondrial membrane potential, cell morphology, and lineage-associated treatment outcomes.
zh_abstract: 大规模预训练可通过测量增强改进 scRNA-seq 表示：即在相同测量过程下，估计同一测量在更高 UMI 深度下会揭示的内容。我们提出 scUNVEIL，这是一种通过下一个 UMI 预测训练的自监督模型。我们证明，贝叶斯最优的下一个 UMI 预测器是任意深度测序所揭示的转录组组成的后验均值。由于在给定转录组组成的条件下 UMI 身份是可交换的，scUNVEIL 使用残差多层感知机直接对计数向量进行运算，无需对基因 token 进行注意力计算。经测量增强的转录组组成由单个低维隐状态预测，因此该隐状态自然可作为细胞嵌入。同一模型既提供可复用的细胞表示，也提供经测量增强的基因表达估计。scUNVEIL 在约9200万个涵盖多种组织的人类细胞上进行了预训练，未使用标签或辅助元数据。在精细细胞类型注释的线性评估中，其零样本表示在被评估的方法中取得最佳性能，同时推理速度比被评估的最强基于 Transformer 的基础模型快1000倍以上，并且在每个细胞输入 UMI 数减少88%的情况下达到该模型的预测性能。进一步评估显示，这些表示可改善对肿瘤反应性、线粒体膜电位、细胞形态以及谱系相关治疗结局的预测。

title: DRAFT: graph-recurrent learning of dynamic gene regulatory networks along single-cell multi-omics trajectories
zh_title: DRAFT：基于图循环学习的单细胞多组学动态基因调控网络推断
summary: 预印本提出结合图注意力与循环记忆的深度学习框架DRAFT，从时间分辨单细胞多组学数据推断动态GRN。
key_points: 图注意力结合循环时序记忆
模拟数据上优于现有方法
在小鼠重编程和果蝇精子发生中获独立数据支持
reason: 新方法有基线对比与独立数据支持，预印本
abstract: Single-cell multi-omics data offer an opportunity to resolve how gene regulatory networks (GRNs) are rewired during cell-fate transitions, but most existing methods infer static snapshots, ignore temporal dependencies or assume linear regulation. Here we present DRAFT, a deep learning framework that combines graph attention with recurrent temporal memory to infer dynamic GRNs from time-resolved single-cell multi-omics data. On simulated data, DRAFT outperforms existing methods in accuracy and temporal smoothness. In mouse cellular reprogramming and Drosophila adult spermatogenesis, it recovers interactions supported by independent ChIP-seq, perturbation and Hi-C data, together with known stage-specific regulators. By inferring regulatory activity from dynamic network structure rather than expression alone, DRAFT identifies regulators whose activity precedes their transcriptional peak, including the candidate early germline regulator Mondo. Germline-specific Mondo knockdown alters germline stem cell number and expression of the predicted targets kuz and mamo. DRAFT also enables nonlinear alignment of co-developing lineages and reveals stage-specific cell-cell communication.
zh_abstract: 单细胞多组学数据为解析细胞命运转变过程中基因调控网络（GRN）如何重构提供了契机，但现有大多数方法推断的是静态快照，忽略时间依赖性，或假定调控为线性。在此，我们提出 DRAFT，一种将图注意力与循环时间记忆相结合的深度学习框架，可从时间分辨的单细胞多组学数据中推断动态 GRN。在模拟数据上，DRAFT 在准确性和时间平滑性方面均优于现有方法。在小鼠细胞重编程和果蝇成体精子发生中，DRAFT 恢复出了得到独立 ChIP-seq、扰动和 Hi-C 数据支持的相互作用，以及已知的阶段特异性调控因子。通过基于动态网络结构而非仅基于表达来推断调控活性，DRAFT 识别出其活性先于转录峰值出现的调控因子，包括候选的早期生殖系调控因子 Mondo。生殖系特异性敲低 Mondo 会改变生殖干细胞数量以及预测靶基因 kuz 和 mamo 的表达。DRAFT 还能够对共同发育的谱系进行非线性比对，并揭示阶段特异性的细胞间通讯。

title: GENECraft: A Function- and Prior-Constrained Discrete Dynamical System for Controllable Regulatory DNA Design
zh_title: GENECraft：功能与先验约束的可控调控DNA设计
summary: 预印本提出免训练的离散动力系统，在推理时耦合基因组语言模型与功能预测器来设计调控DNA序列。
key_points: 耦合Carbon语言模型与AlphaGenome

abstract: Designing regulatory DNA requires reconciling two complementary modeling paradigms: genomic language models (gLMs) capture evolutionary syntax without guaranteeing targeted regulatory activity, whereas sequence-to-function predictors provide explicit functional supervision without enforcing native-like sequence plausibility. We introduce GENECraft, a training-free Function- and Prior-Constrained Discrete Dynamical System (FP-DDS) that couples a genomic language model (Carbon) and a functional oracle (AlphaGenome) during inference-time optimization to balance predicted regulatory activity and consistency with genomic sequence priors. GENECraft evolves continuous latent nucleotide logits while evaluating strictly decoded discrete DNA sequences under a time-dependent composite vector field that fuses normalized functional utility, bidirectional contextual prior guidance, and compositional quality penalties, followed by feasibility-first trajectory readout. Across 2,185 loci spanning promoters, multi-constraint enhancers, and 18 transcription factors (TFs), GENECraft achieves full-joint success rates of 62.70%, 65.23%, and 94.56% (macro-averaged), substantially outperforming seven optimization, evolutionary, and generative baselines (which reach at most 2.15% on enhancers). In matched 336-locus ablations, in-loop Carbon guidance reduces native-relative dinucleotide divergence by 7.8--11.5%, enhancer context sensitivity by 10.5%, and TF mutation sensitivity by 11.0%, establishing FP-DDS as a principled framework for controllable regulatory DNA design.
zh_abstract: 设计调控性 DNA 需要协调两种互补的建模范式：基因组语言模型（gLM）能捕捉进化语法，但不能保证靶向调控活性；而序列到功能预测器提供明确的功能监督，却不能确保序列具有接近天然的合理性。我们提出 GENECraft，一种免训练的功能与先验约束离散动力系统（FP-DDS），在推理阶段优化过程中耦合基因组语言模型（Carbon）与功能预言器（AlphaGenome），以平衡预测的调控活性与同基因组序列先验的一致性。GENECraft 演化连续的潜在核苷酸 logits，同时评估经严格解码的离散 DNA 序列，其依据是一个随时间变化的复合向量场，该向量场融合了归一化的功能效用、双向上下文先验引导和组成质量惩罚，随后采用可行性优先的轨迹读出。在涵盖启动子、多约束增强子和 18 个转录因子（TF）的 2,185 个位点上，GENECraft 的全联合成功率（宏平均）分别为 62.70%、65.23% 和 94.56%，显著优于七种优化、进化和生成式基线方法（后者在增强子上最高仅达 2.15%）。在匹配的 336 个位点消融实验中，环内 Carbon 引导使相对天然序列的二核苷酸差异降低 7.8–11.5%，增强子上下文敏感性降低 10.5%，TF 突变敏感性降低 11.0%，从而确立 FP-DDS 作为可控调控性 DNA 设计的原则性框架。

abstract: [Scientific reports] Artificial intelligence (AI) decision support systems for surgery hold promise but face barriers to adoption, particularly around the interpretability of their outputs. We conducted an international cross-sectional survey of 47 neurosurgeons to evaluate perspectives on literature-derived explanatory techniques for AI-generated anatomical segmentations, using endoscopic pituitary surgery as a high-risk exemplar. Participants ranked certainty scores, certainty maps, saliency maps, scene similarity scores, and nearest-neighbour illustrations, and rated them using a modified Explanation Satisfaction Scale alongside free-text feedback. Certainty-based techniques were consistently ranked and rated highest - valued for aligning with surgical decision-making by conveying confidence (via scores) and anatomical boundaries (via maps). Saliency- and similarity-based methods were judged less clinically relevant and better suited to educational settings. Therefore, certainty-based techniques appear most acceptable to surgeons for improving the interpretability of AI-assisted anatomical navigation systems, though their impact on trust calibration and performance requires prospective evaluation across surgical domains. The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-74953-y.

abstract: [Digital health] The launch of OpenAI's ChatGPT Health for individuals and ChatGPT for Healthcare for institutions marks a major expansion of large language models into health and healthcare delivery. While these products promise efficiency gains and improved access to information, they also raise significant concerns for privacy, patient safety, and the governance of digital health infrastructures. This paper provides an evaluation of OpenAI's health-focused products by examining their systemic implications and outlining public-interest governance models that could better align generative artificial intelligence (AI) with health system goals. Using a document-based analysis of publicly available vendor communications, technical documentation, and policy pages-interpreted through sociotechnical frameworks in health informatics-we evaluate product architectures, data flows, validation claims, and governance mechanisms. Vendor materials indicate that both products may facilitate large-scale aggregation of sensitive health and behavioral data, enabling longitudinal health profiles that raise unresolved questions about data retention, secondary use, reidentification, and cross-border transfers. Despite public claims of safety and high benchmark performance, available validation appears concentrated on narrow tasks and proprietary internal assessments, which cannot substitute for appropriate clinical governance or comprehensive regulatory evaluation. These developments may also deepen dependence on a single global vendor, creating structural risks for digital sovereignty and health equity, particularly in jurisdictions with weaker data protections. Ultimately, generative AI in health should not be framed primarily as a multi-purpose consumer application operated by a monolithic platform, but as a specialized tool embedded within publicly governed digital health infrastructures.
zh_abstract: [Digital health] OpenAI 面向个人推出 ChatGPT Health、面向机构推出 ChatGPT for Healthcare，标志着大语言模型在健康和医疗服务领域的重大扩展。这些产品有望提高效率并改善信息获取，但也引发了对隐私、患者安全以及数字健康基础设施治理的重大关切。本文通过考察其系统性影响，并提出能使生成式人工智能（AI）更好契合卫生系统目标的公共利益治理模式，对 OpenAI 的健康相关产品进行评估。我们对公开可得的供应商通信材料、技术文档和政策页面进行基于文档的分析，并借助健康信息学中的社会技术框架加以解读，评估了产品架构、数据流、验证声明和治理机制。供应商材料表明，这两款产品可能促进敏感健康和行为数据的大规模汇聚，从而形成纵向健康画像，这引发了关于数据留存、二次使用、再识别和跨境传输等尚未解决的问题。尽管公开宣称安全且基准测试表现优异，但现有验证似乎集中于狭窄任务和专有的内部评估，无法替代适当的临床治理或全面的监管评估。这些发展还可能加深对单一全球供应商的依赖，给数字主权和健康公平带来结构性风险，在数据保护较弱的司法辖区尤其如此。最终，健康领域的生成式 AI 不应主要被定位为由单一平台运营的多用途消费者应用，而应作为嵌入公共治理的数字健康基础设施中的专用工具。

abstract: [Cornea] This study aims to elucidate the expanding role of artificial intelligence (AI) in the early diagnosis of corneal and ocular surface diseases. AI has the potential to enhance diagnostic precision, streamline clinical workflows, and facilitate disease detection before clinical manifestations become evident. A narrative literature review was conducted to assess the impact of AI and machine learning in corneal disease preclinical diagnosis. A comprehensive search in PubMed was performed using key terms such as "artificial intelligence," "machine learning," "deep learning," "corneal diseases," and "early diagnosis." Eligible studies were those published in English over the last decade that focused on AI-driven diagnostic approaches and prognostic modeling. Case reports, nonoriginal studies, and those with minimal AI integration were excluded. Data extraction emphasized AI methodologies, imaging techniques, diagnostic performance metrics, and clinical relevance. AI-powered machine learning models analyze vast imaging datasets, detecting subclinical abnormalities imperceptible to conventional diagnostic methods. This capability is particularly significant in early keratoconus detection, dystrophies, infectious keratitis, conjunctival neoplasia, and other corneal pathologies such as dry eye or Steven-Johnson disease, where subtle morphological changes precede clinically apparent disease. The integration of AI into corneal disease diagnostics and management could mark in the future a transformative shift in Ophthalmology, offering precision, efficiency, and scalability. By facilitating early disease detection and individualized patient assessments, AI minimizes diagnostic inconsistencies and accelerates clinical decision making. Continuous algorithm refinement and real-world validation are crucial to maximizing AI's clinical utility. To fully harness AI's potential, multidisciplinary collaboration among ophthalmologists, data scientists, and regulatory bodies is imperative to address standardization, ethical concerns, and implementation barriers. As AI-driven technologies continue to evolve, they will redefine the standard of care in corneal disease diagnosis, therapeutic precision, and patient outcomes.
zh_abstract: [角膜] 本研究旨在阐明人工智能（AI）在角膜及眼表疾病早期诊断中日益扩大的作用。AI 有望提高诊断精度、简化临床工作流程，并在临床表现显现之前实现疾病检测。我们开展了一项叙述性文献综述，以评估 AI 和机器学习对角膜疾病临床前诊断的影响。在 PubMed 中使用“artificial intelligence”“machine learning”“deep learning”“corneal diseases”“early diagnosis”等关键词进行了全面检索。纳入标准为近十年发表的、以英文撰写、聚焦于 AI 驱动的诊断方法和预后建模的研究。病例报告、非原创研究以及 AI 整合程度极低的研究被排除。数据提取侧重于 AI 方法、成像技术、诊断性能指标和临床相关性。AI 驱动的机器学习模型可分析海量影像数据集，检测出传统诊断方法无法察觉的亚临床异常。这一能力对早期圆锥角膜、角膜营养不良、感染性角膜炎、结膜肿瘤，以及干眼或 Steven-Johnson 病等其他角膜病变的检测尤为重要，因为在这些疾病中，细微的形态学改变先于临床上明显的疾病出现。将 AI 整合到角膜疾病的诊断和管理中，未来可能标志着眼科学的变革性转变，带来精准性、高效性和可扩展性。通过促进疾病早期检测和个体化患者评估，AI 可减少诊断不一致并加快临床决策。持续优化算法并进行真实世界验证，对于最大化 AI 的临床效用至关重要。为充分发挥 AI 的潜力，眼科医生、数据科学家和监管机构之间必须开展多学科合作，以解决标准化、伦理问题和实施障碍。随着 AI 驱动技术不断发展，它们将重新定义角膜疾病诊断、治疗精准度和患者结局方面的诊疗标准。

abstract: [Computer methods in biomechanics and biomedical engineering] Accurate recognition of gait phases from surface electromyography (sEMG) signals is essential for intelligent prosthetics, exoskeletons, and rehabilitation. This study proposes a residual convolutional Kolmogorov-Arnold network (RCKAN) that integrates convolutional feature encoding, ridge-regularized nonlinear mapping, and residual learning for five-phase gait classification. Experimental results on data from 40 healthy subjects demonstrate that RCKAN achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 95.52%, surpassing conventional machine learning and advanced deep learning architectures. The model maintains strong performance in transitional phases such as heel strike and toe-off, confirming its robustness and potential for real-time gait analysis and assistive control applications.

abstract: [Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine] BackgroundTracking, classifying, and segmenting cell images are critical clinical tasks essential in diagnosing various diseases such as leukemia and in performing blood counts. While deep neural architectures are preferred for these tasks, the presence of noise in images, overlapping cells, and indistinct cell boundaries make it a challenging endeavor.ObjectiveIn this article, an attention mechanism based on U-Net has been developed for cell segmentation. This attention mechanism enhances detail capture while suppressing irrelevant information.MethodsThe proposed model has been tested on four publicly available cell datasets and evaluated using seven different performance metrics. The performance of the proposed model was benchmarked against state-of-the-art methods.ResultsThe proposed model demonstrated the best overall performance on the dataset named Dataset-III, while it was most successful on Dataset-I. abstract: Modeling systemic failure in high-dimensional environments is fundamentally limited by supervised algorithms that attempt to predict sparse, noisy or censored endpoints. To break this reliance on explicit outcome regression, we engineered the Self-Organizing Survival Manifolds (SOSM) framework, a deep learning architecture that decouples unsupervised representation learning from survival labels and treats time-to-event progression as an emergent geometric property. The system projects heterogeneous multi-omics arrays into a unified latent space governed by a pseudotime-weighted, curvature-minimizing graph Laplacian, organizing patient trajectories along low-dissipation geodesic flows. To validate the framework, we applied this architecture to a 184-patient clear cell renal cell carcinoma multi-omics cohort. Across a deterministic 5-fold cross-validation pipeline, SOSM achieved a mean Concordance Index of $0.768 \pm 0.068$, while out-of-fold risk stratification yielded significant survival divergence (log-rank $p < 0.001$) accompanied by a 14.7% increase in local manifold dissipation among high-risk patients. Furthermore, interrogating the network's encoder weights confirmed that the model autonomously recovered canonical metabolic and microenvironmental drivers of disease progression without supervised feature selection. By demonstrating that systemic failure can be mapped as a geometric phase transition, SOSM establishes a generalizable computational engine for prognostic modeling across biological, industrial and financial complex systems.
zh_abstract: 在高维环境中对系统性失效进行建模，从根本上受限于试图预测稀疏、含噪声或删失终点的监督式算法。为摆脱对显式结局回归的依赖，我们设计了自组织生存流形（Self-Organizing Survival Manifolds，SOSM）框架，这是一种深度学习架构，将无监督表征学习与生存标签解耦，并将事件发生时间的进展视为一种涌现的几何属性。该系统将异质多组学数据阵列投射到统一的潜在空间中，该空间由伪时间加权、曲率最小化的图拉普拉斯算子（graph Laplacian）所支配，使患者轨迹沿低耗散测地流排列。为验证该框架，我们将此架构应用于一个包含184例患者的透明细胞肾细胞癌多组学队列。在确定性的5折交叉验证流程中，SOSM 的平均一致性指数（Concordance Index）为 $0.768 \pm 0.068$，折外风险分层产生了显著的生存差异（log-rank $p < 0.001$），同时高风险患者的局部流形耗散增加了14.7%。此外，对网络编码器权重的探查证实，该模型在没有监督式特征选择的情况下，自主识别出疾病进展的经典代谢和微环境驱动因素。通过证明系统性失效可被映射为一种几何相变，SOSM 建立了一个可推广的计算引擎，可用于生物、工业和金融等复杂系统的预后建模。

title: Reclaiming the Narrative: Why Humanism and Narratology Must Counter the Rise of Algorithmic Medicine.
source: PubMed · Journal of general internal medicine
zh_title: 夺回叙事：人文与叙事学应对算法医学的兴起
summary: 观点文章认为AI可能削弱医患人文关系，主张以叙事医学作为平衡，并提及AI信任差距与自动化偏倚。
key_points: AI诊断精度提升或侵蚀医患互动
指出AI信任差距与自动化偏倚风险
主张叙事医学作为制衡
reason: 常规观点文章，无新数据
abstract: [Journal of general internal medicine] As artificial intelligence (AI) promises diagnostic precision approaching human expertise, medicine faces a profound paradox: expanding technological capabilities risk eroding the human encounter between caregiver and patient. The Age of Reason in medicine has privileged quantifiable, systematized knowledge validated through randomized controlled trials, yet this epistemological dominance threatens to hollow out medicine's humanistic core. While algorithms excel at pattern recognition and prediction, they cannot grapple with ambiguity, uncertainty, or the irreducible complexity of human suffering. AI deployment risks creating an "AI trust gap" and automation bias among clinicians. Narrative medicine offers an essential counterweight, defining illness as a meaningful disruption of a person's life story rather than merely a departure from physiological norms. Empirical evidence demonstrates that narrative medicine training improves empathy, communication skills, and clinical outcomes. This perspective argues for mandatory, longitudinal narrative medicine curricula and institutional reforms that recognize humanistic practice as a core professional competency, ensuring AI serves rather than obscures medicine's irreducible humanity.
zh_abstract: [Journal of general internal medicine] 随着人工智能（AI）有望使诊断精度接近人类专家水平，医学面临一个深刻的悖论：技术能力的不断扩展可能侵蚀照护者与患者之间的人际交往。医学中的理性时代偏重于经随机对照试验验证的、可量化且系统化的知识，但这种认识论上的主导地位有可能掏空医学的人文内核。尽管算法擅长模式识别和预测，却无法应对模糊性、不确定性，或人类苦痛不可化约的复杂性。AI 的部署有可能在临床医生中造成“AI 信任鸿沟”和自动化偏倚。叙事医学提供了一种必要的制衡，它将疾病定义为对一个人生命故事的有意义的扰乱，而不仅仅是对生理常态的偏离。实证证据表明，叙事医学培训可改善共情能力、沟通技巧和临床结局。本观点主张设立强制性的、纵向的叙事医学课程，并进行制度改革，将人文实践视为一项核心职业能力，以确保 AI 服务于而非遮蔽医学不可化约的人性。

title: AI-Assisted Molecular Review Refines SMO Inhibitor Candidacy in SHH Medulloblastoma
zh_title: AI辅助分子复核优化SHH型髓母细胞瘤SMO抑制剂适用性判断
summary: 一例40岁女性不可切除SHH激活型髓母细胞瘤病例，经标准放化疗后影像不明确，NanoString分型与其他结果存在冲突，借助AI辅助分子复核评估SMO抑制剂适用性。
key_points: 成人髓母细胞瘤罕见，SMO抑制剂为超适应症用药
病例治疗后影像不明确，NanoString分为WNT型
AI辅助分子复核用于判断用药候选
reason: 单例病例报告，无对照，属增量档
abstract: AbstractMedulloblastoma is a rare adult central nervous system tumor, most often activated by the sonic hedgehog (SHH) signaling pathway. Standard treatment is maximal safe resection, craniospinal irradiation, and multiagent chemotherapy. No agent has an established maintenance role in any risk group. Smoothened (SMO) inhibitors, which target the SHH pathway, are a candidate, but their use is off-label (i.e., not approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for medulloblastoma), and their optimal timing - or whether they are warranted at all - is unresolved. No randomized trial can settle this, given the rarity of specific genotype-risk combinations in adult medulloblastoma.We present the case of a 40-year-old woman with unresectable, SHH-activated medulloblastoma who received standard chemoradiation. Posttreatment imaging was equivocal. NanoString classified the tumor as WNT, conflicting with methylation and pathology, both of which supported SHH activation. As was later established, a co-occurring TP53 mutation placed her in the very-high-risk category.We used Claude (Anthropic), configured with a custom neuro-oncology instruction set, to integrate pathology, methylation, NanoString, and next-generation sequencing with clinical and imaging data. This was verified against readings by our team's pathologist and neuroradiologist. The synthesis resolved the discordance by weighting methylation as the gold standard, corroborated by GAB1 and beta-catenin staining at the protein level. It identified a mechanistic explanation for the NanoString result and flagged a low-confidence methylation subtype. Next-generation sequencing showed no PTCH1 , SMO , or SUFU mutation; weighed against the tumor's broader molecular context, this placed it in a genotype-indeterminate category for SMO inhibitor response - absence of evidence for benefit, not evidence of absent benefit. No SMO inhibitor was given; we chose close surveillance instead. The patient remains in remission, with an 11-month progression-free survival at last follow-up.To assess whether this synthesis depended on a single model, we repeated the analysis with two additional large language models, Gemini and GPT-5, using identical source reports and instructions. Both reached the same subgroup classification and SMO inhibitor candidacy conclusion, though agreement on the underlying discordance mechanism reasoning was only partial, indicating the conclusion was not tied to any one model's reasoning.
zh_abstract: 摘要：髓母细胞瘤是一种罕见的成人中枢神经系统肿瘤，最常由音猬因子（sonic hedgehog，SHH）信号通路激活。标准治疗为最大限度安全切除、全脑全脊髓放疗和多药化疗。目前尚无任何药物在任何风险组中确立维持治疗的作用。靶向SHH通路的Smoothened（SMO）抑制剂是一种候选药物，但其使用属于超适应证使用（即未获美国食品药品监督管理局批准用于髓母细胞瘤），其最佳使用时机——乃至是否有必要使用——尚未明确。鉴于成人髓母细胞瘤中特定基因型—风险组合十分罕见，任何随机试验都无法解决这一问题。我们报告一例40岁女性，患有不可切除的SHH激活型髓母细胞瘤，接受了标准放化疗。治疗后影像学结果不明确。NanoString将该肿瘤分类为WNT型，与甲基化和病理结果相矛盾，后两者均支持SHH激活。后来证实，其合并存在的TP53突变使她属于极高危类别。我们使用配置了定制神经肿瘤学指令集的Claude（Anthropic），整合病理、甲基化、NanoString和二代测序结果以及临床和影像学数据，并与我们团队的病理医师和神经放射科医师的解读进行了核对。该综合分析通过将甲基化视为金标准解决了结果不一致的问题，并得到蛋白水平GAB1和β-catenin染色的佐证。它为NanoString结果提供了机制性解释，并标记了一个低置信度的甲基化亚型。二代测序未发现PTCH1、SMO或SUFU突变；结合肿瘤更广泛的分子背景考量，这使其归入对SMO抑制剂反应的基因型不确定类别——即缺乏获益的证据，而非存在无获益的证据。未给予SMO抑制剂；我们选择了密切监测。患者仍处于缓解状态，末次随访时无进展生存期为11个月。为评估该综合分析是否依赖于单一模型，我们使用相同的原始报告和指令，用另外两个大语言模型Gemini和GPT-5重复了分析。两者得出了相同的亚组分类和SMO抑制剂适用性结论，但对于结果不一致的潜在机制推理，二者的一致性仅为部分一致，表明该结论并不依赖于任何单一模型的推理。

title: From real to synthetic: PSG-GAN learns sleep apnea signal dynamics for AI training
zh_title: PSG-GAN：合成睡眠呼吸暂停多导睡眠图信号
summary: 提出PSG-GAN，联合合成较长段、多通道的阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停多导睡眠图信号，并保留信号间动态关系；预印本。

EEG/EOG频带功率在各睡眠阶段分布相近

abstract: Synthetic polysomnography (PSG) data has great potential in healthcare applications, for example in substituting real data that is sensitive and challenging to collect. Previous research on synthetic PSG data has been largely focused on short segments of individual signals, overlooking the inter-signal dynamics related to sleep disorders. In this study, we developed a generative adversarial network (PSG-GAN) for co-synthesizing longer segments of multiple PSG signals with diverse and complex characteristics typical of obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). The synthetic signals appeared realistic, and the electroencephalography and electrooculography band powers were similarly distributed across sleep stages. Moreover, the PSG-GAN learned to mirror signal interactions such as changes in photoplethysmography-based heart rate during and after breathing obstructions. An automatic scoring model trained solely with automatically scored synthetic signals reached good performance on sleep staging (\k{appa}=0.71 and 0.63) and respiratory event segmentation (\k{appa}=0.57 and 0.60), on two test sets consisting of healthy volunteers and OSA patients, respectively. This demonstrates the potential of synthetic data in supporting algorithm development for sleep diagnostics. The source code is available at https://github.com/rikuhuttunen/psg-gan.
zh_abstract: 合成多导睡眠图（PSG）数据在医疗应用中具有巨大潜力，例如可替代敏感且难以采集的真实数据。以往关于合成 PSG 数据的研究主要集中于单个信号的短片段，忽视了与睡眠障碍相关的信号间动态关系。在本研究中，我们开发了一种生成对抗网络（PSG-GAN），用于联合合成具有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）典型的多样且复杂特征的多种 PSG 信号的较长片段。合成信号看起来真实，且脑电图和眼电图的频带功率在各睡眠阶段中的分布相似。此外，PSG-GAN 学会了反映信号间的相互作用，例如呼吸阻塞期间及之后基于光电容积脉搏波描记法的心率变化。仅使用自动评分的合成信号训练的自动评分模型，在分别由健康志愿者和 OSA 患者组成的两个测试集上，睡眠分期（κ=0.71 和 0.63）及呼吸事件分割（κ=0.57 和 0.60）均取得了良好表现。这表明合成数据在支持睡眠诊断算法开发方面具有潜力。源代码见 https://github.com/rikuhuttunen/psg-gan。

title: Learning Where and How Much to Sample: Volume-Adaptive k-Space Acquisition for Accelerated MRI
zh_title: 体积自适应k空间采样加速MRI
summary: 提出体积自适应k空间采集框架，仅用ACS测量联合学习采样位置及各层采样预算，同时保持总采集预算精确；预印本。
key_points: 跨层自适应分配采样预算
联合层-频率精炼模块协调采样
总体积采集预算保持精确
reason: 方法有新意但摘要缺少结果与验证信息，预印本
abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is an essential medical imaging technique, but its high costs and long acquisition times can limit accessibility. Accelerated MRI reduces acquisition time through k-space undersampling, yet conventional methods often rely on predefined sampling patterns and uniform slice budgets, overlooking anatomical variations and inter-slice relationships. In this paper, we propose a volume-adaptive k-space acquisition framework that jointly learns where and how much to sample across an entire MRI volume. Using only acquired auto-calibration signal (ACS) measurements, our method exploits volume-wide anatomical information to adaptively allocate sampling budgets across slices while identifying informative k-space lines. A learned joint slice--frequency refinement module coordinates sampling decisions while preserving an exact total volume-level acquisition budget. To reconstruct the acquired measurements, we design a sensitivity-aware synchronous cross-slice reconstruction network that estimates coil sensitivities from ACS measurements and progressively refines neighboring-slice reconstructions while enforcing hard k-space data consistency. Both networks are jointly optimized using reconstruction-based supervision without requiring fully sampled k-space at inference. Experiments on knee and brain MRI across multiple contrasts and acceleration factors demonstrate the adaptive behavior of our acquisition framework and evaluate its reconstruction performance.
zh_abstract: 磁共振成像（MRI）是一种重要的医学成像技术，但其高成本和较长的采集时间可能限制其可及性。加速MRI通过k空间欠采样缩短采集时间，然而传统方法往往依赖预先设定的采样模式和统一的各层采样预算，忽视了解剖结构差异及层间关系。本文提出一种容积自适应的k空间采集框架，可在整个MRI容积范围内联合学习“在何处采样”以及“采样多少”。我们的方法仅使用已采集的自动校准信号（ACS）测量数据，利用全容积的解剖信息，在各层之间自适应地分配采样预算，同时识别信息量大的k空间线。一个经学习得到的层—频率联合精炼模块可协调采样决策，同时保证容积层面的总采集预算精确不变。为重建所采集的测量数据，我们设计了一种敏感度感知的同步跨层重建网络，该网络根据ACS测量数据估计线圈敏感度，并逐步精炼相邻层的重建结果，同时强制执行严格的k空间数据一致性。两个网络采用基于重建的监督进行联合优化，在推理阶段无需全采样k空间。在膝关节和脑部MRI上、涵盖多种对比度和加速倍数的实验，展示了我们采集框架的自适应行为，并评估了其重建性能。

title: Semi-Supervised GAN-Based Segmentation of CTPA Scans for Pulmonary Emboli Boundary Extraction

summary: 提出半监督GAN分割方法，利用大量未标注CTPA扫描，结合多种损失提取肺栓塞边界；预印本。
key_points: 利用大量未标注CTPA数据
Dice与交叉熵损失应对类别不平衡

reason: 常规半监督分割改进，摘要无外部验证，预印本
abstract: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a pulmonary vascular disease associated with high morbidity and mortality, where delayed diagnosis can be fatal. While computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) is the clinical gold standard for PE detection, interpreting these scans manually is time-consuming and error-prone. In this work, we propose a semi-supervised segmentation method, employing generative adversarial networks (GANs) to leverage large pools of unlabeled CTPA scans. The proposed method addresses more effectively the challenges of CTPA image segmentation than previous methods by employing the dice loss and the cross-entropy loss to tackle the highly imbalanced nature of CTPA scans, the feature matching loss to encourage the generator to produce anatomically plausible segmentation maps that are indistinguishable from ground truth, as well as the self-training loss to reinforce learning from highly-confident pseudo-labeled samples. The experimental evaluation on a publicly available dataset shows that the proposed method maintains accurate segmentation, despite a limited number of labeled CTPA scans. with a Dice coefficient of 88.75% and a 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) of 1.74, outperforming fully supervised baselines.
zh_abstract: 肺栓塞（PE）是一种肺血管疾病，发病率和死亡率较高，诊断延误可能致命。虽然CT肺动脉造影（CTPA）是检测PE的临床金标准，但人工解读这些扫描既耗时又容易出错。在本研究中，我们提出一种半监督分割方法，利用生成对抗网络（GAN）来充分利用大量未标注的CTPA扫描。与既往方法相比，所提方法能更有效地应对CTPA图像分割的挑战：采用Dice损失和交叉熵损失处理CTPA扫描高度不平衡的特点；采用特征匹配损失促使生成器产生在解剖学上合理、与真实标注难以区分的分割图；并采用自训练损失，从高置信度的伪标签样本中强化学习。在一个公开数据集上的实验评估表明，尽管带标注的CTPA扫描数量有限，所提方法仍能保持准确的分割，Dice系数为88.75%，95百分位豪斯多夫距离（HD95）为1.74，优于全监督基线方法。

title: LusoClin: A Synthetic Clinical Note Dataset for Medical Information Retrieval in European Portuguese
zh_title: LusoClin：欧洲葡萄牙语合成临床笔记检索数据集
summary: 发布公开的欧洲葡萄牙语合成临床笔记数据集，由微调Llama 3.2 3B生成并用BERT类模型标注实体，支持隐私保护的检索研究。
key_points: 基于真实数据QLoRA微调Llama 3.2 3B生成
自动标注临床实体以支持语义检索
面向低资源语言的隐私保护研究
reason: 公开合成数据集，但规模与验证信息有限
abstract: Access to large-scale clinical text collections is crucial for advancing medical information retrieval research, including clinical note search, patient cohort identification, and domain-adapted retrieval models. However, real clinical notes are rarely available due to privacy regulations, which particularly limits progress for low-resource languages such as European Portuguese. We present LusoClin, a publicly released dataset of synthetic clinical notes in European Portuguese, created to support privacy-preserving research on clinical text retrieval. LusoClin was generated by pre-processing real clinical data, fine-tuning the open-source Llama 3.2 (3B) instruction-tuned model using Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation, and applying prompt-based clinical note generation. To facilitate semantic indexing and clinical search, the notes are automatically annotated with clinical entities using a BERT-based model. We evaluate LusoClin in terms of utility, fidelity, diversity, and privacy using automatic metrics and human evaluation. Results indicate that the dataset captures clinically relevant language patterns and can support downstream IR applications such as clinical document retrieval and domain-specific model adaptation, although annotators can often distinguish synthetic from real notes and some medical inconsistencies persist.

title: DAL: Dynamic Angular Loss for Imbalanced Medical Image Classification
zh_title: DAL：面向类别不平衡医学图像分类的动态角度损失
summary: 针对少类别、严重不平衡的医学图像分类，推导角度间隔与尺度参数边界，提出批自适应角度间隔与动态加权交叉熵结合的损失。
key_points: 推导尺度参数上下界与角度间隔上界
结合批自适应间隔与动态加权交叉熵
在四个高度不平衡医学数据集上验证
reason: 损失函数增量改进，预印本，摘要未见外部验证
abstract: Class imbalance remains a major obstacle in medical image classification, where rare but clinically important classes are often overshadowed by majority categories. Although current strategies for reducing bias, including angle-based softmax (ABS) losses, offer strong discriminative features, their behavior in settings with a small number of severely imbalanced classes remains insufficiently understood. Previous approaches that estimate the intrinsic parameters of ABS rely on the assumption of many classes, which does not hold in medical settings. We derive data-driven upper and lower bounds for the scale parameter and an upper bound for the angular margin using negative-angle statistics, and use these to drive a batch-adaptive angular margin (BAAM), which we combine with dynamically-weighted cross entropy (DWCE) to define our dynamic angular loss (DAL). Across four highly imbalanced medical image classification benchmarks spanning dermatology, ophthalmology, and gastrointestinal endoscopy, our method consistently achieves superior balanced accuracy and the lowest coefficient of variation of per-class recall. Although this entails a small performance reduction on majority classes, the gains on minority categories are substantial, yielding a reliable and equitable overall classifier. Our source code is available at: https://github.com/msalman95/DAL.
zh_abstract: 类别不平衡仍是医学图像分类的主要障碍，罕见但具有重要临床意义的类别往往被多数类别所掩盖。尽管目前用于减少偏倚的策略（包括基于角度的softmax（angle-based softmax，ABS）损失）可提供较强的判别特征，但其在存在少量且严重不平衡类别的情形下的表现仍未被充分理解。以往估计ABS内在参数的方法依赖于类别数量众多的假设，而这一假设在医学场景中并不成立。我们利用负角度统计量推导出尺度参数的数据驱动上界和下界以及角度间隔的上界，并以此驱动批次自适应角度间隔（batch-adaptive angular margin，BAAM），再将其与动态加权交叉熵（dynamically-weighted cross entropy，DWCE）相结合，定义了我们的动态角度损失（dynamic angular loss，DAL）。在涵盖皮肤科、眼科和胃肠内镜的四个高度不平衡医学图像分类基准上，我们的方法始终取得更优的平衡准确率，并且各类别召回率的变异系数最低。尽管这会使多数类别的性能略有下降，但少数类别的提升十分显著，从而得到可靠且公平的整体分类器。我们的源代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/msalman95/DAL。

title: Beyond Cross-Modal Reconstruction: Participant-Level Evaluation of sEMG-Kinematic Coupling in Post-Stroke Gait
zh_title: 脑卒中步态中sEMG与运动学耦合的受试者级评估
summary: 在82名健全者和43名卒中患者留出集上检验双向模型是否捕捉个体特异的肌电—运动学耦合，而非群体共有的时间模式。
key_points: 移除源模态后重建RMSE分别升6.90%和11.38%
设置跨受试者替换与模板基线作对照
比较习得不对称性与简单波形不对称性预测POMA
reason: 样本百余例，评估设计严谨但单一研究、预印本，属增量档
abstract: Accurate cross-modal reconstruction is often treated as evidence of physiological coupling, although it may simply reflect temporal patterns shared across participants. We tested whether frozen bidirectional models captured subject-specific neuromuscular coupling between electromyographic activity and gait kinematics in 82 held-out able-bodied and 43 post-stroke participants. Complete source-modality removal and cross-participant source substitution, along with a cycle-position-age-sex template baseline, were applied. Learned bilateral asymmetry was also compared with transparent waveform and derivative asymmetry for predicting Performance-Oriented Mobility Assessment (POMA) scores in the case of repeated nested cross-validation. Complete source removal increased reconstruction RMSE by 6.90% for electromyography-to-kinematics and 11.38% in the reverse direction. In contrast, cross-participant substitution increased RMSE by only 1.68% and 1.67%, respectively, while the template reduced RMSE by 2.89% and 0.55%. For POMA prediction, walking speed, age, and sex achieved an MAE of 3.693, compared with 4.229 and 4.427 after adding absolute and signed learned asymmetry, respectively. In all of the 20 repeated evaluations, all asymmetry representations performed worse than the covariate baseline. No localized learned feature remained significant after covariate adjustment and false-discovery-rate correction. The model mainly relied on shared gait-phase patterns, with no clear subject-specific coupling or added clinical value. Participant-level controls are therefore needed before reconstruction accuracy is treated as evidence of individualized physiology.
zh_abstract: 准确的跨模态重建常被视为生理耦合的证据，但它也可能仅仅反映了不同参与者之间共有的时间模式。我们在82名留出的健全参与者和43名卒中后参与者中，检验了冻结的双向模型是否捕捉到肌电活动与步态运动学之间个体特异的神经肌肉耦合。我们采用了完全移除源模态和跨参与者源替换的方法，并设置了步态周期位置-年龄-性别模板基线。此外，在重复嵌套交叉验证的情形下，还比较了学习得到的双侧不对称性与透明的波形及导数不对称性对Performance-Oriented Mobility Assessment（POMA）评分的预测能力。完全移除源模态使肌电到运动学方向的重建RMSE增加6.90%，反方向增加11.38%。相比之下，跨参与者替换仅使RMSE分别增加1.68%和1.67%，而模板使RMSE分别降低2.89%和0.55%。在POMA预测中，步行速度、年龄和性别的MAE为3.693，加入学习得到的绝对不对称性和带符号不对称性后分别为4.229和4.427。在全部20次重复评估中，所有不对称性表征的表现均劣于协变量基线。经协变量校正和错误发现率校正后，没有任何局部的学习特征仍具有显著性。该模型主要依赖共有的步态相位模式，没有明确的个体特异耦合，也未带来额外的临床价值。因此，在将重建准确性视为个体化生理的证据之前，需要进行参与者层面的对照。

title: Geometry-bridge flow matching for blind rigid-motion correction in head cone-beam CT
zh_title: 几何桥流匹配用于头部CBCT盲刚性运动校正
summary: 提出3D流匹配先验方法，通过几何桥连接运动伪影与无运动FDK图像，结合位姿估计与数据一致性迭代校正头部CBCT运动。
key_points: 几何桥以投影器几何导数提供解析速度目标
即插即用循环结合样条位姿估计与TV正则
在CQ500的30例留出病例模拟扫描上评估
reason: 仅模拟数据的预印本方法，无真实外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Rigid motion of a patient head during head cone-beam CT (CBCT) scan can degrade image quality and complicate recovery of accurate anatomical structures from the measured projections. We present a 3D flow-matching prior approach that learns the image changes induced by motion. Its geometry-bridge connects motion-corrupted and motion-free Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstructed images of the same source volume through progressively reduced simulated motion. The forward projector's geometry derivative supplies analytic velocity targets along this path. A plug-and-play loop encompasses the learned image updates together with spline-based pose estimation, conjugate-gradient data consistency, and image total-variation regularization. Both the refined image volume and the FDK reconstructed image volume at the estimated poses are evaluated. On simulated 360-view scans from 30 held-out CQ500 patients with nominal per-component motion amplitudes within 10 mm / 10 degrees, the framework achieved state-of-the-art image reconstruction quality and motion accuracy in comparison with other methos such as learned autofocus and diffusion-based joint reconstruction. Mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) reached 37.1 dB and mean detector-plane reprojection error (RPE) was 0.27 mm. With matched endpoints at the inference settings, the geometry bridge improved PSNR by 1.6 dB and reduced RPE by 33% relative to image-linear training. With 50 prior updates and coarse-to-fine motion estimation, total processing time averaged 9.1 minutes per patient on an RTX A6000.
zh_abstract: 头部锥形束CT（CBCT）扫描期间患者头部的刚性运动会降低图像质量，并使从测量投影中恢复准确解剖结构变得复杂。我们提出一种三维流匹配先验方法，用以学习由运动引起的图像变化。其几何桥通过逐步减小的模拟运动，将同一源体积的运动伪影与无运动Feldkamp-Davis-Kress（FDK）重建图像连接起来。前向投影器的几何导数为这一路径提供解析的速度目标。一个即插即用循环将学习得到的图像更新与基于样条的位姿估计、共轭梯度数据一致性以及图像全变分正则化结合在一起。我们对精修后的图像体积以及在估计位姿下的FDK重建图像体积均进行了评估。在来自30名留出的CQ500患者的模拟360视角扫描中（各分量名义运动幅度在10 mm / 10度以内），与学习式自动对焦和基于扩散的联合重建等其他方法相比，该框架取得了最先进的图像重建质量和运动精度。平均峰值信噪比（PSNR）达到37.1 dB，平均探测器平面重投影误差（RPE）为0.27 mm。在推理设置下端点匹配时，与图像线性训练相比，几何桥使PSNR提高1.6 dB，RPE降低33%。在进行50次先验更新并采用由粗到细的运动估计时，在RTX A6000上每位患者的总处理时间平均为9.1分钟。

title: Beyond the Black Box: A 30-Minute Artificial Intelligence Critical Appraisal Workshop for Internal Medicine Residents.
source: PubMed · MedEdPORTAL : the journal of teaching and learning resources

summary: 开发并实施30分钟工作坊，训练住院医师评估大语言模型输出，2025年7至12月共开展六场。

abstract: [MedEdPORTAL : the journal of teaching and learning resources] Artificial intelligence (AI) and large language models (LLMs) are rapidly entering resident workflows. However, formal training on appropriate LLM use is limited, and AI outputs may be inaccurate, outdated, or biased. This creates a curricular gap: residents may use AI before receiving guidance on evaluating AI-generated recommendations. We developed a 30-minute AI critical appraisal workshop for postgraduate year 1 to 3 (PGY-1-PGY-3) internal medicine residents. The workshop replaced 1 evidence-based medicine (EBM) journal club session during ambulatory continuity clinic blocks. Six workshops were delivered from July to December 2025. Learners prompted an LLM using a fictional patient scenario, compared outputs in small groups, and learned a structured appraisal framework. Anonymous surveys were collected immediately before and after the workshop using QR (quick-response) codes. Of 72 eligible residents, 53 completed preworkshop surveys and 44 completed postworkshop surveys. Responses were anonymous and unpaired, so results were analyzed descriptively. Confidence critically appraising AI output increased from 60.4% preworkshop to 79.5% postworkshop. Concern about inaccurate AI predictions increased from 69.8% to 88.6%, and concern about AI bias increased from 77.4% to 88.6%. Belief that AI improves health outcomes remained high: 94.3% and 97.7%. Overall, 90.5% rated the session 4 or 5 out of 5. A brief, required workshop teaching residents AI literacy and critical appraisal skills was feasible and well received. Postworkshop respondents reported greater confidence in critically appraising AI output and greater concern about inaccurate predictions and bias than preworkshop respondents. The curriculum is adaptable, requires minimal technology, and can be integrated into existing EBM teaching.
zh_abstract: [MedEdPORTAL：教学与学习资源期刊] 人工智能（AI）和大语言模型（LLM）正迅速进入住院医师的工作流程。然而，关于恰当使用LLM的正式培训十分有限，且AI输出可能不准确、过时或存在偏倚。这造成了课程上的空白：住院医师可能在获得如何评估AI生成建议的指导之前就已开始使用AI。我们为内科第1至3年（PGY-1至PGY-3）住院医师开发了一个30分钟的AI批判性评价工作坊。该工作坊在门诊连续性诊疗轮转期间取代了1次循证医学（EBM）期刊俱乐部课程。2025年7月至12月共举办了6场工作坊。学员使用一个虚构的患者情景向LLM发出提示，在小组中比较输出结果，并学习一个结构化的评价框架。通过二维码（QR码）在工作坊前后即刻收集匿名问卷。在72名符合条件的住院医师中，53人完成了工作坊前问卷，44人完成了工作坊后问卷。回答为匿名且未配对，因此采用描述性分析。批判性评价AI输出的信心由工作坊前的60.4%上升至工作坊后的79.5%。对AI预测不准确的担忧由69.8%上升至88.6%，对AI偏倚的担忧由77.4%上升至88.6%。认为AI可改善健康结局的比例仍然很高：分别为94.3%和97.7%。总体上，90.5%的受访者将该课程评为4分或5分（满分5分）。一个简短的必修工作坊向住院医师传授AI素养和批判性评价技能，是可行的且受到好评。与工作坊前受访者相比，工作坊后受访者报告对批判性评价AI输出更有信心，并对不准确预测和偏倚更为担忧。该课程具有可调整性，所需技术极少，可融入现有的EBM教学。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Estimating Adjusted Treatment Effects in Presence of Nonspecific Treatment Responses: A Trial Simulation Study in Major Depressive Disorders.
zh_title: AI校正非特异性治疗反应以估计抑郁症试验治疗效应：模拟研究
summary: 在重度抑郁症试验模拟中，用AI估计的非特异性反应概率作倾向得分权重，结合MMRM校正基线不平衡对治疗效应估计的偏倚。
key_points: 以1-(prob-NSRT)为权重的PSW-MMRM方法

abstract: [Innovations in clinical neuroscience] Randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trials (RCTs) are the gold-standard approach for assessing treatment effect (TE), typically defined as baseline-corrected difference in clinical scores between active and placebo arms. Uncontrolled baseline variation in individuals' probability of exhibiting a nonspecific response to treatment (prob-NSRT) can introduce bias in the estimation of TEs, as conventional study designs and statistical methods generally fail to account for imbalances in such confounding factors. Recently, a novel methodology was proposed for assessing TE conditional to prob-NSRT estimated using artificial intelligence. The 1-(prob-NSRT) value was used as weight (propensity score weighted [PSW]) in a mixed model repeated measures (MMRM) analysis to assess TE by controlling the potential confounding effects of unbalanced baseline prob-NSRT distributions. Clinical trial simulations were conducted to explore multiple trial protocols (scenarios) and to identify alternative and more generalizable approaches for analyzing and reporting RCT results. The objective of this analysis was to compare the outcomes of PSW and the reference unadjusted analysis using simulated RCT data characterized by different baseline prob-NSRT distributions and to assess potential risk of inflating Type I/II errors. The simulations indicated that when using the unadjusted analysis, the risk of inflated Type I error increases with the increase of prob-NSRT and the risk of Type II error increases with the decrease of prob-NSRT. The PSW methodology achieved better control of baseline imbalance in nonspecific response distributions, yielding an estimated TE that was independent of prob-NSRT distributions. These findings provide convergent evidence highlighting the potential of PSW as the preferred approach for analyzing RCTs.
zh_abstract: [Innovations in clinical neuroscience] 随机、安慰剂对照临床试验（RCT）是评估治疗效应（TE）的金标准方法，TE 通常定义为活性药物组与安慰剂组之间临床评分经基线校正后的差值。个体对治疗出现非特异性反应的概率（prob-NSRT）在基线时存在未受控的差异，可能给 TE 的估计带来偏倚，因为传统的研究设计和统计方法通常无法考虑此类混杂因素的失衡。最近，有人提出了一种新方法，用于评估以利用人工智能估计的 prob-NSRT 为条件的 TE。该方法将 1-(prob-NSRT) 的值作为权重（倾向评分加权 [PSW]），用于重复测量混合模型（MMRM）分析，通过控制基线 prob-NSRT 分布不平衡所带来的潜在混杂效应来评估 TE。研究进行了临床试验模拟，以探索多种试验方案（情景），并确定分析和报告 RCT 结果时可替代且更具普适性的方法。本分析的目的是，使用具有不同基线 prob-NSRT 分布的模拟 RCT 数据，比较 PSW 与作为参照的未调整分析的结果，并评估 I 类/II 类错误膨胀的潜在风险。模拟结果表明，使用未调整分析时，I 类错误膨胀的风险随 prob-NSRT 升高而增加，II 类错误的风险随 prob-NSRT 降低而增加。PSW 方法更好地控制了非特异性反应分布的基线失衡，所得 TE 估计值与 prob-NSRT 分布无关。这些发现提供了一致的证据，凸显了 PSW 作为分析 RCT 的首选方法的潜力。

abstract: Behavioral addictions, such as problematic gaming, gambling, social media use, and online shopping, have emerged as a growing global concern with significant psychological, social, and economic consequences. Traditional assessment and treatment approaches, while clinically grounded, often struggle with scalability, accessibility, and long-term engagement. In recent years, advances in digital technologies and artificial intelligence (AI) have enabled the development of novel, data-driven solutions for the prevention, detection, treatment, and recovery of behavioral addictions. This book presents a comprehensive survey of the management of behavioral addictions through digital technologies, bridging clinical foundations with state-of-the-art computational approaches. This book aims to provide researchers, clinicians, and practitioners with a unified, interdisciplinary perspective on the opportunities and limitations of AI-based digital technologies in behavioral addiction management,and to highlight pathways toward more scalable, personalized, and effective intervention strategies.

title: BI-SCUDO Regression - A novel algorithm to infer clinical variables from omics datasets

summary: 提出基于样本内排序与网络预测的组学回归框架，免去复杂归一化；合成基准中对噪声稳健，并在TCGA队列中表现优于对比方法。
key_points: 基于样本内排序，无需复杂归一化

reason: 新方法预印本，有基线对比但证据有限
abstract: Regression analysis of high-throughput omics data is often made difficult by noise, batch effects, and the loss of information resulting from the discretization of continuous variables. Existing machine learning algorithms often struggle to extract stable biological signals under these heterogeneous conditions. We introduce BI-SCUDO Regression, a rank-based regression framework designed for omics data analysis. By leveraging within-sample rankings and network-based predictions, BI-SCUDO Regression bypasses the need for complex normalization and provides robust, interpretable results. In synthetic benchmarks, BI-SCUDO Regression demonstrated strong resilience to noise, maintaining predictive and feature-selection stability under conditions in which standard models exhibited performance degradation. When applied to cohorts from TCGA datasets, BI-SCUDO Regression consistently outperformed LASSO, Random Forest Regression, and XGBoost in predicting survival, with an average increase in Ratio of Performance to Deviation ranging from 43% to 86%, depending on the comparator. Furthermore, the algorithm consistently identified parsimonious, statistically significant, and biologically relevant biomarkers, with enrichment for cancer-related terms across all stage stratifications. Although BI-SCUDO Regression incurs higher training times due to its genetic optimization strategy, it offers a robust and interpretable approach to outcome prediction and biomarker discovery, with potential applications in precision medicine, where noisy data compromise the performance of conventional regression methods.
zh_abstract: 高通量组学数据的回归分析常因噪声、批次效应以及连续变量离散化造成的信息损失而变得困难。现有的机器学习算法在这些异质条件下往往难以提取稳定的生物学信号。我们提出了 BI-SCUDO Regression，一种为组学数据分析设计的基于秩的回归框架。通过利用样本内排序和基于网络的预测，BI-SCUDO Regression 无需复杂的归一化，并能提供稳健且可解释的结果。在合成基准测试中，BI-SCUDO Regression 对噪声表现出较强的抗性，在标准模型性能下降的条件下仍能保持预测和特征选择的稳定性。应用于 TCGA 数据集的队列时，BI-SCUDO Regression 在预测生存方面始终优于 LASSO、随机森林回归（Random Forest Regression）和 XGBoost，根据对比方法的不同，性能偏差比（Ratio of Performance to Deviation）平均提高 43% 至 86%。此外，该算法始终能够识别出精简、具有统计学显著性且具有生物学相关性的生物标志物，并在所有分期分层中均富集于癌症相关条目。尽管 BI-SCUDO Regression 因其遗传优化策略而训练时间较长，但它为结局预测和生物标志物发现提供了一种稳健且可解释的方法，在噪声数据会损害传统回归方法性能的精准医学中具有潜在应用价值。

title: Flux Transformer learns intracellular metabolic fluxes from isotope labeling and measured reaction rates
zh_title: Flux Transformer：从同位素标记与反应速率学习胞内代谢通量
summary: 预印本提出基于反应特异注意力的AI模型，整合同位素标记与反应速率数据重建稳态代谢通量。
key_points: 在含噪模拟数据上训练
识别通量优于传统MFA
降低非专家使用门槛
reason: 新方法但主要为模拟数据，预印本
abstract: Cells convert incoming nutrients into energy and biomass via metabolic fluxes. Quantifying these fluxes involves feeding cells isotope-labeled nutrients, quantifying metabolite labeling patterns, and inverting the labeling data to retrieve the underlying flux distribution. Traditional metabolic flux analysis (MFA) is both computationally expensive and frequently requires manual refinement of the cost function to obtain plausible results. For this reason, MFA has remained inaccessible to non-experts. Here we present Flux Transformer, an AI model that uses reaction-specific attention to integrate isotope-labeling data with available reaction-rate measurements, reconstructing mass-balanced steady-state fluxes. The model is trained on simulated data with added noise and identifies the underlying fluxes from these data more effectively than traditional MFA. Provided experimental data from wild-type and mutant bacteria, yeast, plants, and mammalian T cells, it efficiently and accurately recovers expert-curated MFA fluxes. By making flux analysis accessible, Flux Transformer is poised to accelerate metabolic research and engineering.
zh_abstract: 细胞通过代谢通量将摄入的营养物质转化为能量和生物质。定量这些通量需要给细胞提供同位素标记的营养物质，定量代谢物的标记模式，并对标记数据进行反演以获得潜在的通量分布。传统的代谢通量分析（MFA）计算成本高，且常常需要人工调整代价函数才能得到合理的结果。因此，非专业人员一直难以使用 MFA。在此，我们提出 Flux Transformer，这是一种人工智能模型，利用反应特异性注意力将同位素标记数据与已有的反应速率测量值整合，重建质量平衡的稳态通量。该模型在添加了噪声的模拟数据上训练，与传统 MFA 相比，能更有效地从这些数据中识别潜在通量。在给定野生型和突变型细菌、酵母、植物以及哺乳动物 T 细胞的实验数据时，该模型能够高效、准确地还原由专家整理的 MFA 通量。通过使通量分析变得易于使用，Flux Transformer 有望加速代谢研究和代谢工程。

title: Machine Learning Approaches to Biologic Therapy Response in Inflammatory Bowel Disease: A Review Article.

abstract: [Sage open pathology] Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), encompassing Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, remains a complex and heterogeneous condition with variable response to biologic therapies. Despite significant advances with anti-TNF agents, integrin inhibitors, and interleukin-12/23 blockers, treatment outcomes are limited by primary nonresponse, secondary loss of efficacy, immunogenicity, and substantial healthcare costs. The advent of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) algorithms, offers new opportunities to address these challenges by integrating diverse clinical, laboratory, imaging, histologic, genetic, and microbiome data. Recent studies demonstrate that AI-based models achieve high accuracy in predicting biologic response, remission, and adverse outcomes, outperforming conventional statistical approaches. AI has also shown promise in real-time endoscopic assessment, histologic grading, and forecasting disease progression, enabling earlier intervention and personalized therapy. However, current models are constrained by limited datasets, heterogeneity, lack of large-scale prospective validation, and concerns regarding interpretability, transparency, and patient privacy. Future efforts should prioritize multicenter trials, external validation, and ethical integration into clinical workflows. Collectively, AI-driven prediction of biologic therapy response represents a pivotal step toward precision medicine in IBD, with the potential to optimize therapeutic strategies, reduce ineffective treatment exposure, and improve patient outcomes.

abstract: [Nature communications] Monitoring large-scale neuronal activity in deep brain circuits is crucial for understanding the principles of brain function. However, existing large-scale cellular-resolution imaging techniques are limited in imaging depth and cannot monitor activity in areas deeper than the cortex in the intact brain. To address this challenge, we developed a Large Imaging Field of view Three-photon (LIFT) microscope with a FOV of > 3 mm2. LIFT combines high-numerical-aperture optimized sampling, using a custom scanning module, with deep learning-based denoising, to enable population imaging in subcortical brain regions of mice and deep cortical regions of rats. We demonstrate calcium imaging in the intact mouse brain from more than 1500 cells across CA1, the surrounding white matter, and adjacent deep layers of the cortex, and show population imaging with high SNR at a depth of 1.2 mm in the rat cortex. The LIFT microscope offers versatility in imaging scale and rate and was built entirely from off-the-shelf components.

abstract: Brain tumors are among the most lethal neurological disorders, with over 308,000 new diagnoses annually worldwide. Accurate classification of tumor type from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans is critical for treatment planning; however, manual radiological interpretation is time-consuming and prone to inter-observer variability. This paper proposes an automated deep learning pipeline for four-class brain MRI classification (glioma, meningioma, no tumor, and pituitary tumor) using EfficientNetB3 transfer learning with a custom classification head. A two-phase training strategy is adopted: Phase 1 trains the head with a frozen backbone (best validation accuracy: 92.77%), and Phase 2 selectively fine-tunes the top 37 layers at a 100x reduced learning rate (best validation accuracy: 94.91%). On an independent balanced test set of 1,600 MRI images, the system achieves 90.62% overall accuracy and a macro-average AUC of 0.9854. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) is integrated for class-discriminative visual explainability. The proposed system simultaneously addresses three dimensions absent in prior work: high accuracy, CPU-only computational efficiency, and clinical interpretability.

abstract: Hip fractures represent a significant clinical challenge because they cause excess disability and mortality, and have a growing incidence in aging populations, as bone fragility increases. Although finite element analysis (FEA) provides biomechanical assessment of femoral strength, its clinical applicability is mainly limited by high computational cost. Conventional machine learning (ML) approaches have been explored as surrogate models for FEA; predictions are fast but fail to capture the spatial and topological structure of finite element meshes. To address these limitations, this study proposes a hybrid Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based framework for femoral stress prediction using graph-structured finite element modeling (FEM) data. The proposed GCN-SAGE-Residual architecture combines graph convolution, neighborhood aggregation, and residual learning to model spatial dependencies and stress propagation across mesh elements. We systematically evaluated 14 models in a primary comparison, spanning classical ML methods and baseline GNN architectures, complemented by a targeted architectural ablation that isolates the contribution of each component of the proposed design. Evaluation results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid architecture achieves the strongest predictive performance among all evaluated models. The proposed hybrid model achieves the best performance with an R^2 score of 0.8022 and mean absolute error of 2.879 MPa, highlighting the importance of incorporating mesh topology in biomechanical prediction tasks. The proposed framework provides a scalable and computationally efficient alternative for FEM-based orthopedic analyses and fracture risk assessment. The code is publicly available on GitHub.

abstract: A System 1 model answers a multiple-choice question in a single pass. A frozen language model turns the question and each option into vectors, two small, trained heads place them in a shared space, and the closest option wins. The design has been shown on agent decisions, but we are not aware of a study of how far it goes on exam questions that need medical knowledge, where the right option is often no more similar to the question than the wrong ones. We rebuilt the recipe from scratch for MedMCQA and trained only two projection heads and one temperature on top of frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B, Granite-4.2-3B and Qwen3-8B, using a contrastive loss with in-batch and hard negatives and a mask for repeated answers. With plain last-token vectors, both small encoders answer about one question in three correctly (33.1% and 33.0% on 3,842 held-out questions, where chance is 25.0%). Writing each text inside a one-word-summary prompt and lowering the learning rate of the heads raised this to 41.7% and 42.5% for the two small encoders and to 46.0% +-0.2 (three seeds) for Qwen3-8B. Shuffling the questions against the options returns accuracy to chance, so the heads do use the question. Flan-PaLM and Med-PaLM 2 report 57.6% and 72.3% on MedMCQA under a different protocol, so ours is a cheap, fast baseline and not a competitive system. We also say what our evidence cannot show: validation gains were about 1.7 to 2 times the test gains, and we could not separate the effect of reading several encoder layers from the other changes.
zh_abstract: 系统1模型一次前向即可回答多项选择题。冻结的语言模型将问题和每个选项转换为向量，两个小型的、经训练的头部将它们置于共享空间中，最接近的选项胜出。该设计已在智能体决策上得到验证，但就我们所知，尚无研究探讨其在需要医学知识的考试题目上能走多远，而这类题目中正确选项往往并不比错误选项更接近问题。我们为MedMCQA从头重建了这一方案，仅在冻结的Qwen3.5-0.8B、Granite-4.2-3B和Qwen3-8B之上训练两个投影头和一个温度参数，使用包含批内负例和困难负例的对比损失，并对重复答案使用掩码。使用普通的末词元向量时，两个小型编码器约每三题答对一题（在3,842道留出题目上分别为33.1%和33.0%，随机水平为25.0%）。将每段文本置于“一词概括”提示中，并降低头部的学习率后，两个小型编码器的准确率提高到41.7%和42.5%，Qwen3-8B提高到46.0% ±0.2（三个随机种子）。将问题与选项打乱配对后，准确率回落到随机水平，说明这些头部确实利用了问题信息。Flan-PaLM和Med-PaLM 2在不同协议下报告的MedMCQA准确率分别为57.6%和72.3%，因此我们的方法是一个廉价、快速的基线，而非有竞争力的系统。我们也说明了证据所不能证明的内容：验证集上的提升约为测试集提升的1.7至2倍，并且我们无法将读取多个编码器层的效果与其他改动的效果区分开来。

abstract: Small language models (SLMs) can run on commodity hardware and support privacy-preserving, on-premises clinical deployment, but their medical explanations are often short and poorly structured compared with large language models. Recent supervised approaches such as Meerkat transfer chain-of-thought reasoning into 7B-8B backbones, yet their training objective does not directly target the style or organization of the generated rationales. Building on the instruction-tuned Mistral-7B backbone, we investigate whether a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) step can improve explanation structure without human preference labels.We apply Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with LoRA adaptation to 2,000 Meerkat-derived medical prompts, guided by a simple self-supervised reward that favors longer, lexically diverse, and well-punctuated responses while penalizing very short ones. Training for about 170 PPO steps on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU yields a stable increase in the average reward. Quantitative and qualitative comparisons show that the RL-tuned model produces longer, more organized, multi-point explanations while preserving the underlying medical content.We discuss the promise and the limitations of self-rewarded RL for shaping the style of medical explanations.
zh_abstract: 小语言模型（SLM）可在通用硬件上运行，并支持保护隐私的本地化临床部署，但与大语言模型相比，其医学解释往往简短且结构欠佳。近期的监督学习方法（如 Meerkat）将思维链推理迁移至 7B–8B 参数的骨干模型中，但其训练目标并未直接针对所生成解释（rationale）的风格或组织结构。我们以经指令微调的 Mistral-7B 为骨干模型，探究一个轻量级强化学习（RL）步骤能否在无需人类偏好标注的情况下改善解释的结构。我们采用结合 LoRA 适配的近端策略优化（PPO），在 2,000 条源自 Meerkat 的医学提示上进行训练，并以一种简单的自监督奖励为指导：该奖励偏好更长、词汇更丰富且标点规范的回答，同时惩罚过短的回答。在单块 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上训练约 170 个 PPO 步，平均奖励稳定上升。定量与定性比较表明，经 RL 调优的模型能生成更长、更有条理的多要点解释，同时保留了原有的医学内容。我们讨论了自奖励强化学习在塑造医学解释风格方面的前景与局限。
